description: Search the Georgian national film catalogue (kinokatalogi, National Archives of Georgia) — 652 newsreels, documentaries and features. Filter by title with `name`; returns each film with its release year, genre, and its directors and camera operators as {id, name} objects carrying the catalogue's own person ids. Paginates 15 at a time with a true total.

locale.description: Interface locale for the returned labels: ka (default) or en.

name.description: Title substring to filter on, e.g. "თბილისი". Omit to list the whole catalogue. This is the only filter the upstream honours — it silently ignores any other parameter and returns everything.

page.description: Page number, 15 films per page. Defaults to 1.

name: archives_film_search
title: Archives Film Search
